name: Chief Durrak Brandhand
place: dungeon kiln_forge set B (The Slag Heaps, Kiln Ridge, level 17-20): the end boss in the great forge
_doc: The Slagborn war-chief of Kiln Ridge, who forges the gangs' weapons himself. P1 "At the Anvil": a hammer cone, a red-hot brand he presses on the tank (stacks; swap at 3), and sparks off the anvil. Two slag-cooling pillars: his Forge Blast (hide behind one) cracks them. P2 at 60% "Call the Smiths": his smiths come running (a shield that holds while they live) while molten iron is poured from the crucible in lines. P3 new bar "Quenched in Anger": he plunges into the quench tank and comes out steaming — steam on each player, a three-player stack, and a hammer slam that knocks far. OWNER #51 (2026-10-15): the phase that refilled the health bar is removed; the health bar is the whole fight.
party: Solo: hard — the brand needs a tank swap or a follower. 2-3: two tanks if you can. 5: as designed.

pull: Durrak sets down a blade, picks up a hammer. "Hold them still, I want to see the temper."
"Every Slagborn blade on this ridge, I made. Every one."
say.death: Durrak drops his hammer on the anvil. It rings for a long time.
say.reset: "Back to work." Durrak picks up the blade he was finishing.

enrage.say: "ENOUGH. Into the fire with all of you!"

forge_blast.name: Forge Blast
forge_blast.say: The forge roars open — get behind a slag cooler!

pour.name: Pour the Crucible
pour.say: Molten iron pours across the floor!

phases.name: Call the Smiths
phases.shieldDown: The last smith falls — Durrak has to fight his own battles now!

onEnter.say: Durrak hides behind his smiths. Kill the three smiths to break his ward! It fails by itself in 20 seconds.

ward.say: Durrak hides behind his smiths. Kill the three smiths to break his ward! It fails by itself in 20 seconds.
ward.fade: The ward fails by itself. No opening this time.

do.say: Both slag coolers are cracked through. Nothing will stop the next blast.
